statistic: beta_G point estimate from exact source/target FE regression on z(G_st) plus frozen controls
null_calibration: one-sided least-favourable Monte Carlo envelope across private A reference distributions
p_value: maximum across A of (1 + count(reference_A >= observed_beta_G))/(N_reference + 1)

gates.private_null: Wilson 95% upper rejection bound <=0.10 for every evaluation A
gates.evaluable_MDE: smallest beta_G grid point with Wilson 95% lower power bound >=0.80 for each A; no MDE if its null cell is unqualified

note: This is a newly named development estimator with fresh seeds. It does not alter or rescue the closed v0.1 asymptotic rule.
